title: KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2610.35869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI applications often invoke a model before they determine whether inference is necessary. That default is useful for ambiguous generative tasks, but it is poorly matched to work that is structured, deterministic, policy-bound, lookup-oriented, or directly verifiable. KORA introduces deterministic-first execution control: a pre-inference control layer that represents requests as task paths, attempts deterministic or structured routes first, validates route outcomes, records telemetry, and escalates to a model-candidate path only when deterministic handling is insufficient. This paper presents KORA as a deterministic-first execution-control architecture and reports bounded evidence from reproducible benchmark and validation workloads. translated_title: KORA：面向AI工作负载的确定性优先执行控制
translated_abstract: AI应用常常在判断推理是否必要之前就调用模型。这种默认做法对模糊的生成式任务很有用，但对于结构化、确定性、受策略约束、面向查找或可直接验证的工作来说并不匹配。KORA引入了确定性优先的执行控制：一个推理前的控制层，它将请求表示为任务路径，首先尝试确定性或结构化路由，验证路由结果，记录遥测数据，并且仅在确定性处理不足时才升级到模型候选路径。本文将KORA作为一种确定性优先的执行控制架构提出，并报告了来自可复现基准测试与验证工作负载的有界证据。在一个可复现的100任务确定性密集型基准测试中，与朴素的直接基线相比，KORA控制的执行避免了100次模拟模型调用中的80次，且在确定性处理中零不匹配。
tldr: KORA提出了一种“确定性优先”的推理前执行控制架构，优先尝试确定性和结构化路由来处理请求，仅在确定性处理不足时才升级到模型调用，在基准测试中避免了80%的模拟模型调用且结果零不匹配。
en_tdlr: KORA introduces a deterministic-first pre-inference execution control architecture that attempts deterministic or structured routes first and escalates to model inference only when insufficient, avoiding 80 of 100 simulated model invocations with zero mismatches in benchmarks.
